boards.evidenceRef: https://infor.pinpointhq.com/postings.json (197 live postings observed; real Bengaluru and Hyderabad India roles including Data Scientist, Software Engineer, Security Analyst; the underlying ats-batch-2.mjs pinpoint parser was fixed to read the actual { data: [...] } JSON:API shape the live endpoint returns, and its object-shaped location field)

boards.notes: https://razorpay.pinpointhq.com, https://zeta.pinpointhq.com, and https://innovaccer.pinpointhq.com all resolve to HTTP 200 with a company-branded title tag, but every posting returned is the identical generic Pinpoint demo/template content ("Head of DEI - UK", "Marketing Manager", "Customer Service Rep" with boilerplate descriptions), not the real Indian company's own postings. Treated as unverifiable squatted/demo tenants and not added, per the no-fabrication constraint.

boards.evidenceRef: https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/blue-altair?state=published (11 live jobs, several Pune, India observed)
boards.notes: The adapter's default https://apply.workable.com/api/v3/accounts/<id>/jobs endpoint returns HTTP 404 for every account probed (including known-live Workable customers), so an explicit endpoint override to the v1 widget API is required.
